name: Road back-to-back travel fade
hypothesis: A road club playing the second night of a back-to-back after a long flight under-performs the originated line more often than chance.
universe: every game in the rolling window whose travel row is complete (no blank arena coordinate)
rule: take the home side to cover the originated spread when the away club is on a back-to-back, its travel distance is >= 1000 miles and |blend_margin| <= 8.0
refusals: no bet if either club's luck z-score is outside +-1.96 (noise band)
no bet if any travel cell for the game is blank
no bet if the official injury report has not been filed for that game date
settlement: home covers when (home_pts - away_pts) > (-blend_margin); a push settles as a loss. Settled from the official final score.
status: frozen — not eligible for publication until it clears its gates
